192.name: Sunflora
192.flavor: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

193.name: Yanma
193.flavor: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

194.name: Wooper
194.flavor: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

195.name: Quagsire
195.flavor: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

196.name: Espeon
196.flavor: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

197.name: Umbreon
197.flavor: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

198.name: Murkrow
198.flavor: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

199.name: Slowking
199.flavor: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

200.name: Misdreavus
200.flavor: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

201.name: Unown
201.flavor: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

202.name: Wobbuffet
202.flavor: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

203.name: Girafarig
203.flavor: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

204.name: Pineco
204.flavor: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

205.name: Forretress
205.flavor: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

206.name: Dunsparce
206.flavor: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

207.name: Gligar
207.flavor: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

208.name: Steelix
208.flavor: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

209.name: Snubbull
209.flavor: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

210.name: Granbull
210.flavor: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

211.name: Qwilfish
211.flavor: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

212.name: Scizor
212.flavor: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

213.name: Shuckle
213.flavor: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

214.name: Heracross
214.flavor: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

215.name: Sneasel
215.flavor: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

216.name: Teddiursa
216.flavor: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

217.name: Ursaring
217.flavor: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

218.name: Slugma
218.flavor: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

219.name: Magcargo
219.flavor: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

220.name: Swinub
220.flavor: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

221.name: Piloswine
221.flavor: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

222.name: Corsola
222.flavor: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

223.name: Remoraid
223.flavor: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

224.name: Octillery
224.flavor: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

225.name: Delibird
225.flavor: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

226.name: Mantine
226.flavor: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

227.name: Skarmory
227.flavor: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

228.name: Houndour
228.flavor: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

229.name: Houndoom
229.flavor: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

230.name: Kingdra
230.flavor: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

231.name: Phanpy
231.flavor: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

232.name: Donphan
232.flavor: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

233.name: Porygon2
233.flavor: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

234.name: Stantler
234.flavor: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

235.name: Smeargle
235.flavor: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

236.name: Tyrogue
236.flavor: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

237.name: Hitmontop
237.flavor: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

238.name: Smoochum
238.flavor: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

239.name: Elekid
239.flavor: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

240.name: Magby
240.flavor: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

241.name: Miltank
241.flavor: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

242.name: Blissey
242.flavor: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

243.name: Raikou
243.flavor: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

244.name: Entei
244.flavor: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

245.name: Suicune
245.flavor: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

246.name: Larvitar
246.flavor: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

247.name: Pupitar
247.flavor: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

248.name: Tyranitar
248.flavor: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

249.name: Lugia
249.flavor: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

250.name: Ho-Oh
250.flavor: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

251.name: Celebi
251.flavor: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

252.name: Treecko
252.flavor: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

253.name: Grovyle
253.flavor: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

254.name: Sceptile
254.flavor: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

255.name: Torchic
255.flavor: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.
